Kai: Quick heads-up — I ran a targeted canary adjusting dynamic token budgets per route/tier and noticed intermittent p95 spikes tied to kernel handoff + cold KV hits. Posting summary and a tiny config I used.
Asha: SGTM, drop the config. did you capture perf traces?
Kai: Yep. Attaching the important bits inline. The regression shows up when short-seq chat routes get re-routed from fast fp16 kernels to fallback kernels mid-request (kernel switch cost ~4-6ms at 512 tokens in our run) and at the same time kv-cache misses spike ~2x for the same route.
Marta: ugh that combo is rough — kernel switchover + cold KV = amplified tail. can you share the trace snippet?
Kai: paste: ```trace snippet
kernel_switch: route=chat-small tier=prod time_us=4500
kv_lookup: hits=0 miss_cost_us=1800
batch_size: 6 -> 3 (prefetch prune)
queue_wait_ms: 8.2
```
Jordan: what's the token-budget policy you tested? any abrupt reallocation across tiers?
Kai: policy used: ```
{ "route_tiers": {"chat": {"target_p95_ms": 150, "token_budget": 48}, "embedding": {"target_p95_ms": 60, "token_budget": 24}}, "rebalance_window_ms": 200 }
```  (canary at 3% of pods, route-weighted)
Olivia: interesting — rebalance_window 200ms is pretty aggressive. might be causing oscillation when KV warms. try 800ms + hysteresis.
Asha: Also, when kernel cost is close to batch-margin, the batch splitter sometimes reduces microbatching, causing more frequent kernel selection. Could add a cost buffer.
perf-bot: Canary started: 3% pods, canary_id=canary-2026-03-18-07. Metrics will stream to #eng-runtime-observability.
Marta: From the flame graphs I saw: a 12% p95 bump localized to route=chat-small. Embedding routes unchanged.
Kai: Proposed next step: bump rebalance_window to 800ms, add a kernel_cost_buffer_ms=5 for routes with kv_miss_rate>0.1, and enable prefix-KV warmup for first 3 requests of a new route instance. Rollout to 5% for 30m.
Jordan: ACK. One ask: log an event when kernel handoff reason != affinity so we can correlate. Also emit kv_miss_rate per route in the budgeting agent.
Olivia: +1. Add a canary test for long-tail short conversations (<=64 tokens) — those were the most likely to flip kernels.
Asha: tiny nit: prefer "kernel_cost_buffer_ms" as an additive param rather than % — easier to reason about with microseconds traces.
Kai: noted. I'll submit a small config patch and trigger canary. patch: ```
config:
  rebalance_window_ms: 800
  kernel_cost_buffer_ms: 5
  kv_warmup_first_n: 3
  canary_percent: 5
```
perf-bot: Canary update: canary-2026-03-18-07 at 5% deployed, collecting p50/p95/p99 every 30s.
Marta: If the p95 stabilizes within 10% of baseline for 30m, we can do a progressive roll to 25%. If not, revert and capture full perf traces.
Jordan: I'll add log hooks for kernel handoff reasons and kv miss rate. ETA 2hrs.
Olivia: I'll add the test harness scenario and run a short A/B load to validate microbatch behavior.
Kai: Thanks — I'll post results in ~30-40m. tagging @Asha @Marta for visibility. :thumbsup:
